products.title: Sue Adores a Scallop
products.body_html:
Hand-built in Tennessee
Made to order · 4–6 weeks

Some tables you set. This one you set the scene around.

Sue Adores a Scallop is the mahjong table you'd been picturing before you had the words for it — hand-finished, softly scalloped, quietly show-stopping. Pour the rosé, text the group chat, and let her be the prettiest thing in the room. She's made for long afternoons and later-than-planned nights: the game, the gossip, the one-more-round.

And when the last tile is played, she does the one thing a beautiful game table is never supposed to do — she folds flat and slips into a closet like she was never there. All the drama, none of the footprint.

Choose your finish

  • Marshmallow — our signature creamy white. Clean, timeless, goes with everything. (Standard)
  • Dusty Rose — a warm, flushed blush. (Upgrade)
  • Sultry Sage — a grounded, dusty green. (Upgrade)
  • Pearlescent Marshmallow — the marshmallow you love, lit from within with an opal shimmer that shifts as you move around her. (Premium)

A generous 35″ square

Room for your heirloom leatherette mat and the whole ritual around it — racks, dice dish, coasters, everyone's glasses, and your NMJL card. Nothing crowded, nothing left off the table.

Dimensions and weight

  • 35″ wide × 35″ deep × 30″ tall, seats 4.
  • Folds to 5.5″ thick — slides under a bed, behind a door, or into the back of a closet.
  • 40 lb — light enough for one person to carry and set up alone, solid enough that she does not shift mid-game.

The details

  • Hand-built in Tennessee, one table at a time, by a small team in a small workshop.
  • Built to order, just for you — please allow four to six weeks to receive your table.
  • Hand-shaped scalloped apron, turned bobbin legs, and a smooth painted finish — legs fold flat for storage.
  • Hand-finished; every table carries small, beautiful variation that makes it only yours.

Shipping

A flat $295 anywhere in the lower 48, packed and insured. We are not shipping to Alaska, Hawaii, US territories or APO/FPO addresses yet, and not internationally.

Pay over time

Fall for her now, pay on your terms. Split your table into monthly payments at checkout with Shop Pay Installments — terms from three to twenty-four months. No application; you'll see your exact rate and monthly payment before you commit to anything.

Offered through Affirm. Rates from 0–36% APR. Subject to eligibility; your terms are shown at checkout.

Care

Wipe with a soft, dry cloth. For spills, blot with a barely damp cloth and dry straight away. Avoid harsh cleaners, abrasives, and standing moisture.

Can she go outside?

For an afternoon, yes. Sue is sealed for protection and she is perfectly happy on a covered porch or a patio for the length of a game. She is an indoor table that visits outside — she is not an outdoor table. She should never be left out overnight, and never in wind, rain, or even light precipitation. Bring her in when the last tile is played.

Sun, damp and temperature swings age any hand-finished piece. We seal her well, but we cannot guarantee against wear that comes from leaving her in the elements, and that kind of damage is not a manufacturing defect.

Enhance your Mahjong set up with a set of our four racks with scallop-edge pushers.  Crafted from thick, clear acrylic, each rack features magnets that snap the pusher back into place when building walls, and secures it on top of the rack when not in use.  Lovely scalloped edges grace each pusher and add a unique aesthetic to your table! Artistry & Craftsmanship

Each tile is crafted from premium, custom-engraved acrylic, then individually hand-painted with the iconic color palette of the French and Italian Rivieras for exceptional depth and dimension. Slightly larger than tournament size, with extra-large numerals, the set offers excellent legibility and a luxurious hand-feel during play.
